protocol.title: Options implied-volatility surface skew (EVAL-71 put-minus-call near-ATM IV skew) -> signal-timed delta-hedged risk reversal with correct mark-path net-of-cost P&L: traded-form monetization falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-72 / EVAL-75 (identical correct mark-path net-of-cost delta-hedged traded form) but a different, on-charter traded structure: a RISK REVERSAL (nearest OTM call + nearest OTM put) driven by the EVAL-71 surface SKEW rather than an ATM straddle driven by level/skew or term structure; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the risk-reversal (skew-structure) monetization complement to EVAL-71's predictive skew. EVAL-57 traded a static VRP straddle (NO-GO), EVAL-61/62 traded an order-flow-timed ATM straddle (NO-GO), EVAL-72 traded an EVAL-71 level/skew-timed ATM straddle (NO-GO), and EVAL-75 traded an EVAL-74 term-structure-timed ATM straddle (NO-GO), so a skew-timed risk reversal is genuinely new
protocol.signal_detail: skew = mean(put near-ATM iv) - mean(call near-ATM iv) over the trailing window (EVAL-71 helper, reused verbatim)
protocol.position: side_k = sign(z_k); exposure_k = min(|z_k|, SIZE_CAP); causal decision at bar k; z_k = expanding-z of the causal EVAL-71 surface skew
protocol.traded_form: risk reversal (front expiry; nearest OTM call = smallest strike > spot; nearest OTM put = largest strike < spot; IV backed out of the real mark via EVAL-57 helpers) with the EVAL-62 mark-path net-of-cost P&L on the signed long-call/short-put aggregate mark/delta: delta-hedge + half real 2-leg spread + hedge fee, spot-normalized
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one grid config, net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, nonzero positions > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

floor.note: EVAL-76 consumes both the traded-instrument data (surface snapshots / perp candles / option trades; EVAL-61/62 floor) and the surface skew signal data (per-bar near-ATM option trade tape; EVAL-71 surface floor). Both sealed floors are reused verbatim and BOTH must pass; neither is weakened. This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.
